packageRules.description: D-003, Chief 2026-08-18: patch and minor updates merge on their own once Renovate sees the tests pass. This is the routine path and needs no human.
D-003, Chief 2026-08-18: major upgrades never merge on their own. They group into one pull request and wait for Chief, because a major is the only dependency change that routinely breaks a boundary.
D-003, Chief 2026-08-18: lock file maintenance merges on its own; it moves no declared version.
